name: notepad-demo
description: Smoke test for the executor: activate Notepad, type a line, save with Ctrl+S. Uses no OCR or template targets, so it runs without the vision module.

steps.comment: Bring Notepad forward so the keystrokes land in it rather than whatever happened to be focused.
Give the window manager a moment to finish the focus change.
The interval keeps slower editors from dropping characters.
An unsaved buffer opens a Save dialog here; continue either way so the smoke test still reports the typing result.
Proof of what the screen looked like at the end of the run.
